purpose: Document first-party registry discovery, current public portal behavior, bounded anonymous request outcomes, and safety limits.
assessment: Official BOGIS material establishes a Borno state registry custodian relevant to Gamboru. The official public portal is an account-based land-application workflow. No anonymous safe ID-plus-complete-polygon response was obtained.
registryAssessment: Local/state registry custody found through official BOGIS sources. This is distinguished from general national surveying agency information and is not treated as proof of open parcel geometry or citywide coverage.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Official BOGIS site describes the Borno State Geographic Information Service and land/property administration services.

Official BOGIS application portal offers land-title/deed applications, requires account-based submission, and lists survey plans and related documents among application requirements; it is not an anonymous parcel feature service.

Official Borno regulations identify the BOGIS File Archive as the depositary for registration books, land files, survey files, layouts, title-deed plans, registers, and related plans/maps, and describe the BOGIS Digital Data Repository.
